sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, welcome Alsager Town to their home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of W-D-W-W-W, and will face an Alsager Town side struggling near the foot of the table on just 4 points. This should present a strong opportunity for the league leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they can maintain their recent form of D-W-W-L-W-D. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a meeting of mid-table contenders, with Bridgnorth in particularly strong recent form (L-W-W-W-W-W) despite their sole recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, joint-third with 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home, while in-form Bilston Town (W-W-D-W-D-W) host Foley Meir. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills in a fixture between teams in mid-table difficulty, and Crewe host Allscott Heath as both sides seek to climb away from the lower reaches. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, who occupy the basement with just 2 points, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's lowest-ranked sides. Shawbury United, winless in their last five matches, host Barnton in what represents a crucial game for the home side's fortunes.
